summary: Stores input a2 as a float blend factor at this+0xA8, clamps it to the range [0.01, 1.0] (floor literal 1008981770, ceiling literal 1065185444), then writes 1.0/factor at this+0xAC and 1.0/(1.0-factor) at this+0xB0. Crossfade/interpolation coefficient preparation.

operations.description: Store input a2 as float into field this+0xA8 (blend factor).
If factor at this+0xA8 is below 0.01f, clamp it up to 0.01f (literal 1008981770).
If factor at this+0xA8 exceeds 0.99f, clamp it down to 1.0f (literal 1065185444).
